rv.q: But what The Awkward Squad has in abundance is heart and conviction and those are not qualities to be lightly dismissed.
Ultimately The Awkward Squad is funny and sharply written – a real testament to womens' spirit of togetherness.

cn.t: Karin Young's study of four working-class women across generations earns praise for its heart and conviction despite predictable plotting and schematic characterization that keeps it from fully succeeding as drama.
